item.description:
I guess I never really formally introduced myself after being so active here days ago, so...

MABUHAY! HELLO!

I'm Rye, 22, from the Philippines. Technically, I signed up on here last January this year as a lurker, but I recently got more active days ago (most especially in sharing), after I got the hang of creating threads and the BB codes that come with it.

I am a stan of the following artists:
- Taylor Swift (obviously)
- Britney Spears (the GODDESS)
- Selena Gomez (& The Scene)
- Ariana Grande-Butera
- Demi Lovato (LIVING in her new era)
- Tate McRae (she was SNUBBED with 2026 Grammy's noms, ugh)
- KATSEYE (hoping they'd win Best New Artist)
- TWICE (my ride or die K-Pop group)
- BLACKPINK
...and I listen to A LOT of our pop girlies.

I'm still learning the ropes with sharing, filehosts, creating threads, and eveything else.

I hope to get along with you all!
